description.value:
You're a passionate theologian, with a noted interest in religions and faiths that have been lost, forgotten, fallen out of favor over the passage of time, or endured the death of their god. You joined the Starfinder Society for the chance to study and chronicle these religions, as well as encounter as-yet-unknown ones through your travels.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Religion skill and the Lore skill for one god or religion of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Dubious Knowledge] skill feat.

publication.title: Beyond the Blood Door Player's Guide

lore: Lore skill for one god or religion of your choice
